_meta.source: Ctrnact engine, out-of-ring rings ZZ[zeta_18] (9-fold) / ZZ[zeta_20] (5-fold), exact development
_meta.note: Star-bearing tilings carrying a tile whose symmetry order n does NOT divide 24 (9/18 at D=18, 5/10/20 at D=20). n is a combinatorial invariant, unlike alpha, which is a FREE parameter for flexing families: a family exists at every alpha in its range, so 'this snapshot's alpha is off the zeta24 grid' does NOT make it out-of-ring — it is an alpha-sample of an in-ring family and belongs to the star24full shelf. --contains now also matches star tokens (9*/18*), which the bare-token regex missed. candidate:true = not in Myers' out-of-ring k=1 set.
